mainText:
Good afternoon. Weather in Prishtina: 9 degrees now, light rain. Next 24 hours: high 11, low 8.

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said hundreds of thousands of Ukrainians were left without electricity after Russian attacks hit power infrastructure in four regions overnight.

Kosovo's Deputy Prime Minister Avdullah Hoti warned that the government missed the legal deadline for approving the 2027 budget, calling it a breach of the law.

Prime Minister Edi Rama appointed Vlera Gjakova, a native of North Macedonia who has lived much of her life in Kosovo, as his new media advisor.

Granit Dervisholli stepped down as head coach of Trepça '89 following the team's 2-1 home defeat to Kika.

Albanian mixed-martial-arts fighter Endrit Brajshori knocked out his opponent in the first round to win at the OKTAGON 96 event on Saturday.
